question: A normal white cell count (WBC) reliably excludes infection in a patient with suspected infected non-union.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — WBC is unreliable in chronic infection. CRP and ESR are the preferred inflammatory markers; micro-organisms are confirmed only by culture of deep tissue samples or bone biopsy.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: That is actually incorrect. WBC is often normal in chronic osteomyelitis. CRP and ESR are more sensitive markers; definitive diagnosis requires tissue biopsy and culture.
